title: aithales rubens
intro: Aithales rubens, commonly known as Red Alder or Red alder, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America and Europe. The plant is known for its ability to provide health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aithales rubens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Aithales rubens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
